name: Kashidashi Tsuma, Marina no "Netorase" Houkoku 3 Case. Moto Kareshi & Binkan Tsuma
original_name: 貸し出し妻、満里奈の“ネトラセ”報告3 CASE.元彼氏＆敏感妻
source:
A "netorase" play—where a husband lends his wife to another man.
It had been about a year since Kenji, the husband, had lent his beloved wife, Marina, to a former adult film actor.

Over time, Kenji began to feel an even stronger desire: he wanted to see Marina willingly cheat on him, driven by her own desires.

Then, one day, Marina received a message from her ex-boyfriend—the first contact in over a decade. He wanted to rekindle their relationship, with marriage as the goal.
Marina, of course, turned him down. But when Kenji heard about it, he confessed the darker, more forbidden desire he’d been harboring:
"I want you to get back together with your ex."

This was different from before. This time, it would all be Marina’s choice—a relationship she entered willingly.
As her ex continued to pursue her, determined to win her back, Marina found herself at a crossroads. What would she do—?

translation:
一种“寝取らせ”玩法——丈夫把自己的妻子借给另一个男人。

丈夫健二把心爱的妻子真理奈借给一名前成人电影演员，已经过去约一年了。

随着时间推移，健二产生了更加强烈的欲望：他想看到真理奈出于自己的欲望，自愿背叛自己。

某天，真理奈收到了前男友的消息。这是他们十多年来的首次联系。他想以结婚为目标，重新发展两人的关系。
真理奈当然拒绝了他。但健二得知此事后，却坦白了自己一直藏在心底、更阴暗也更禁忌的欲望：
“我想让你和前男友复合。”

这次与之前不同。一切将由真理奈自己选择——她会自愿踏入这段关系。
前男友继续追求她，决心挽回旧爱；真理奈则站在了人生的岔路口。她会怎么做——？
